name: dbcx-agentic-loop
description: Evidence-first agentic loop for consulting deliverables: agents analyse a client's material, critics from the client side and the standard side, with separate evidence, check every statement, and a final gate reads the result as the client's stakeholders would. Methods: code analysis, enterprise architecture landscape, requirements, technology scoring, technology-fit estimation. Formula-driven Excel deliverables, a live run dashboard and a guided onboarding.
